name: pipeline_benzene_anharmonic
purpose: TASKS 211: the anharmonic step's first real run - the pipeline on benzene with the step asked for (--anharmonic-minutes 120), so that the GFN2-xTB force field is computed by the pipeline itself from its own geometry, in its own systemd scope (probes/run_in_scope.sh, 1536 MB, 2 dxtb processes of 2 threads), with both deliveries written. Steps 2-3 come from the corpus (--reuse-only: no psi4 and no pyscf calculation). The run decides the pipeline's default, which is 0 (off) until it has passed four checks, read by probes/results_m1/anharmonic_step_2026-11-16/first_run_checks.py on the result folder: every band's step within about 1 cm-1 of the stored-field certificate, no band lost beyond the stored case (28 of 30 stepped), degenerate pairs with equal steps, time and peak memory recorded. A stored force field of a 12-atom molecule took 19 minutes on this laptop at two processes (probes/results_m1/s2_xtb_2026-10-18)
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name benzene --smiles c1ccccc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_benzene_anharmonic_first_run --threads 4 --reuse-only --anharmonic-minutes 120

estimate.basis: the stored GFN2-xTB force field of a 12-atom molecule took 18.8 minutes at two processes (probes/results_m1/s2_xtb_2026-10-18); steps 1-5 with the corpus's steps 2-3 reused take under a minute (probes/runspecs/pipeline_benzene_reuse.json)

memory.basis: a bound for the WSL side: probes/run_in_scope.sh runs the force field and its label in a systemd scope with MemoryMax 1536 MB and no swap; beside it the Windows python of the pipeline with the network's three checkpoints and kernel ridge on 1,600 rows: under 0.8 GB. --reuse-only: neither psi4 nor pyscf runs
